title: Firmware and IoT
description: Firmware images read-only, the agent reaches only its provider; binwalk for extraction, KVM for emulation if you give it.

de.title: Firmware und IoT
de.description: Firmware-Images nur lesend, der Agent erreicht nur seinen Anbieter; binwalk zum Entpacken, KVM zur Emulation, wenn Sie es angeben.

prompt: Extract the firmware in /mnt/firmware with binwalk (its MCP server sees the same folder as /work: /mnt/firmware/fw.bin is /work/fw.bin there), find the file system, services, hard-coded credentials and versions with known vulnerabilities. Write /work/firmware-report.md.
notes: binwalk runs in a container of its own and gets the firmware folder read-only at its /work for this start (--mcp-mount binwalk:/work=FOLDER:ro). What it extracts stays in its container's /tmp unless you gave it a writable folder at /out once (sandbox-ai mcp set binwalk --mount /out=DIR:rw); add DIR to the start with --mount DIR:/mnt/extracted:ro to let the agent read the extracted files.
